_internalReasoning: Exhaustively extracted all menu items across both plates. Categorized dishes strictly into macronutrient clusters with <=10% variance, segregating clear vegetable broths, whole marine Omega-3 fish meal sets, protein side dishes, high-fat/fried preparations, salted fish, and ultra-processed gelatinized starches (Seblak/noodles). Aligned recommendations to manage the patient's high sodium (3000mg), saturated fat (27.7g), added sugar (45g), and carbohydrate excesses while providing adequate protein.
summary: This menu features traditional Indonesian dishes ranging from nourishing clear soups and whole marine fish to heavily deep-fried items and spicy processed starches. Given your high sodium (3000mg) and saturated fat (27.7g) surpluses, opting for clear vegetable broths and whole marine omega-3 fish meal sets while avoiding deep-fried items and seblak will help optimize your metabolic profile.
